name: spec-to-pr
description: Evidence-backed Codex workflow for full brief delivery, legacy migration, feature E2E, and Figma implementation into draft pull requests.

interface.shortDescription: Turn briefs, migrations, features, and Figma into verified draft PRs.
interface.longDescription: SpecToPR provides four strict deliveries on a seven-tool workflow: brief/Figma/OpenAPI full delivery, separate-project legacy migration, feature-targeted E2E and video, and mock-backed Figma implementation with measured visual evidence and safe draft publishing.
defaultPrompt: Use workflow_info, choose one of the four strict delivery modes, then call workflow_start once.
Keep API and UI in one context; use Figma or running legacy as the measured visual baseline.
Publish the packet-bound 15-section draft report without dropping required validation.
